quarterly_data.quarter: Roche-Genentech press release: Roche's collaborator MediLink announces phase III data for (09-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Collaborator MediLink Therapeutics released interim results from the randomised phase III TAISHAN-302 trial of Tam-Peli (tambotatug pelitecan, YL201), a B7-H3-targeted antibody-drug conjugate, versus topotecan in 451 Chinese patients with relapsed small-cell lung cancer (SCLC). The trial met its overall survival primary endpoint: median OS 13.3 vs 9.4 months (HR 0.46, p<0.0001); median PFS 7.4 vs 2.8 months (HR 0.29); confirmed objective response rate 59.1% vs 9.7%; Grade 3 or higher treatment-related adverse events 46.4% vs 74.7%. China's CDE accepted the New Drug Application for filing. Tam-Peli holds U.S. FDA and China CDE Breakthrough Therapy Designations in relapsed SCLC. It is Tam-Peli's second positive phase III readout, after TAISHAN-301 in nasopharyngeal carcinoma. Under a January 2026 exclusive licence, Roche holds development, manufacturing and commercialisation rights worldwide outside mainland China, Hong Kong and Macau, is advancing clinical development there across multiple solid tumour types and plans to rapidly initiate global phase III trials.
